toolsPreview.name: list_active_deals
toolsPreview.description: List currently active flash-sale deals from verified Heartly merchants. Returns deals sorted by ending soonest. Filters are optional and combinable.

toolsPreview.name: search_deals_by_category
toolsPreview.description: Search active deals filtered by category. The category argument is required. Other filters (country, min_discount_pct, ending_within_hours) are optional.

toolsPreview.name: get_deal_by_id
toolsPreview.description: Look up a single active deal by its Heartly internal id (UUID).
